extensionDescription.message: Inspect cookie banners, consent categories, cookies, and traffic deltas after opt-out.

legalDisclaimer.message: this is not legal advice. please still review the content. the creator takes no liability for the results.

popupIntro.message: Get a quick read on what the page really does before and after consent.

scanStatusNeedsAccess.message: Page access is needed for a full scan.

scanStatusDeltaFound.message: Delta found in the current scan.

legendGreenBody.message: All cookies appear covered by consent.

legendYellowBody.message: The situation is unclear or mixed.

legendRedBody.message: A non-essential tracker appears to run without consent.

legendBadgeNote.message: This status matches the badge in the extension bar.

cookiesTrafficIntro.message: This overview groups visible cookies and locally stored browser data. The list updates after each scan.

storageOverview.message: Found local data: LocalStorage $1, SessionStorage $2, IndexedDB $3.

noLocalStorageVisible.message: No locally stored data was found for this tab.

deltaIntro.message: Compares the current state with a best-effort "deny all" state. CookieBuddy flags cookies and third-party requests that remain after opt-out.

helpIntro.message: CookieBuddy looks at the current page and checks whether cookies or third-party requests still happen after you choose “deny all”.

helpStepBanner.message: It tries to recognize the cookie banner provider.

helpStepCookies.message: It lists visible cookies and likely services.

helpStepDelta.message: It compares what happens before and after opt-out.

helpStepReview.message: If something remains, treat it as a review signal, not as a final legal finding.

privacyIntro.message: CookieBuddy does not track you and does not send scan results to the creator or to any analytics service.

privacyLocalOnly.message: Scans run locally in your browser.

privacyStorage.message: The last scan is stored only in Chrome local extension storage on your device.

privacyNoAnalytics.message: There is no analytics, tracking pixel, remote logging, or account system.

privacyExternalLinks.message: External links and drafted emails only open when you click them; those external services have their own privacy rules.

openSourceIntro.message: CookieBuddy is intended to be open source. Contributions, bug reports, and banner-detection improvements are welcome.

bannerOverviewNotFound.message: No banner settings button was found.

bannerOverviewFailed.message: Could not open the banner overview on this page.

noCookiesVisible.message: No cookies visible to the extension for this tab.

cookiesTrafficEmptyState.message: No visible cookies or locally stored data were found for this page.

deltaCheckingDescription.message: Trying a deny-all action, then comparing cookies and third-party traffic. This is best-effort because banners use different controls.

deltaConsentPrompt.message: Please decline all cookies on the page first. When you are ready, confirm to start the delta check.

deltaConsentCancelled.message: Delta check cancelled. No changes were made.

deltaNeedsPageAccess.message: This page does not allow the delta check. Open a normal website and run the test there.

deltaNeedsManualConsent.message: I could not find a visible banner or deny option. Please decline all cookies manually first, then run the delta check again.

deltaCheckFailed.message: The delta check could not be completed.

deltaFoundSummary.message: CookieBuddy found cookies or third-party traffic after opt-out. This may mean data still flows without valid consent and should be reviewed.

noDeltaSummary.message: No obvious post-opt-out delta was found in this browser session.

mailBody.message:
Hello,

I reviewed the consent behavior on $1 and would like to ask about cookies or third-party traffic after opt-out.

Kind regards

contactDraftHint.message: These buttons open a mail draft addressed to the company DPO. Please adjust the text before sending.

contactEditReminder.message: The sample texts are templates and should be adapted to the specific case before sending.

mailPersonalizeHint.message: Please review and fill in the marked details, the concrete context, and the personal data before sending.

accessMailBody.message: I hereby request information about the processing of my personal data by $1. In particular, please tell me which data is processed, for what purposes, on which legal basis, and to whom the data may be disclosed.

correctionMailSubject.message: Request to correct personal data at $1

correctionMailBody.message: I hereby request correction of my personal data at $1. Please review and correct the following details or the data stored by you: [please add the details].

deletionMailSubject.message: Request to delete personal data at $1

deletionMailBody.message: I hereby request deletion of my personal data at $1. Unless overriding retention obligations apply, please delete the following data or tell me which data is still stored: [please add the details].

bfdiName.message: Federal Commissioner for Data Protection and Freedom of Information

bfdiNote.message: Fallback: Graurheindorfer Straße 153, 53117 Bonn, phone +49 (0)228-997799-0, email poststelle@bfdi.bund.de.

noDenyButtonClicked.message: No deny-all button could be clicked automatically.

detailsIntro.message: This page shows the last analysis stored locally by the extension.

germanAuthorityNote.message: Germany has state-level authorities. The exact authority depends on the company seat shown in the imprint.

localAuthorityNote.message: CookieBuddy could not infer a specific authority from the domain. Check the company imprint or privacy notice for jurisdiction.
